reviewer (error): The printed token ends ...dhararamatiḥ, i.e. adardhar + aramatiḥ. A visarga form adardhaḥ before a- would be adardho 'ramatiḥ, so the verb must end in r: adardhar, 3 sg. imperfect of the intensive of √dhṛ (dardharti). The split word does not match the printed text.
